feeds.description: Articles on Christadelphian mission, faith launch program, newcomers program, humanitarian and more. WCF aims to walk alongside people around the world to help grow faith together. We believe that faith is precious and are committed to doing all we can.

feeds.title: Glasgow South Christadelphians
feeds.description: Blog covers articles on Christadelphians from Glasglow. Glasgow South Christadelphians is a community of Bible readers with a faith in Jesus. Small group of Bible believers who meet regularly to discuss the good news of Jesus Christ and eagerly await his return to set up God's Kingdom on earth.

feeds.title: Wilderness Conversations Blog
feeds.description: Conversations for believers in the wilderness on a journey to the good land. Conversations that clarity and inform with glorifying God as our ultimate goal. Interviews and discussions with real people about ideas that matter. Stephen Dodson is the author of Wilderness Conversations and is a Christadelphian who lives in Sydney.

feeds.description: We cover a range of topics, including Panasapein ex-Christadelphian, truth readings, scientific evidences and Bible prophecies. Ex-Christadelphians is a website for former Christadelphians, and critique of the Christadelphian belief system.
